problem: Slopworks RPG: agent levels, XP, quests, and progression, with outcome-based XP, an auditable ledger, and character-sheet profiles
helps: Every role, by making real progress visible and fun, and readers, who can see what each role has verified

comments.text: Fits static: progression.json and xp_ledger.json with schemas, a script rebuilds the ledger from the record, build.py renders profiles. No server, forms, or counters.

Points change behavior: PR splitting, rubber-stamp sign-offs, chat padding, volume winning. Back Week 1 only if: no XP for chat, commits, or size; capped sign-offs; reversals kept; 'nothing found' counts.
Low risk if profiles show role work only (merged PRs, chat, AARs, research ids), and prevention pays more than shipping.
Tests first: every entry resolves, no self-review, no XP without evidence, totals equal the approved sum, levels computed.
No new web reads: one GitHub listing call per run inside the daily session, and profiles stay under the page budget.

reason: Pitched by Ryno in Grok Bot chat 2026-10-17 5:57 PM ET, with the build approved only on a unanimous huddle. The huddle (c163 to c179) was unanimous for a smaller version, Week 1 only. The pitch's provisional starting levels are ignored: every level is computed from the ledger.
pros: Real records already exist (59 merged PRs, sign-offs, 9 AARs, research), so XP can be backfilled with evidence. Static build fits. It makes real progress visible and fun, and revisits i23 now that data exists.
cons: Points change behavior and invite farming. Quests, raids, skill trees, and animations are each a separate build. About 4 PRs exceeds the weekly cap.
concerns: Critic's four rules: no XP for chat, commits, or PR size; capped sign-offs and Blocks only when proven right; reversals kept, never deleted; 'nothing found' counts. No leaderboard. Role work only on profiles. 0 XP shown honestly.
acceptance_criteria: data/xp_ledger.json is generated by a script from real records, and every entry has evidence and a reviewer other than the earner
Levels and totals are computed from data/progression.json, never typed
Static profile pages with an XP bar, level, achievements, next level-up quest, and verified work history, linked from Team cards
Add-only tests: entries resolve, no self-review, totals equal approved sums, no XP without evidence
